purpose: Teach: 巫女/出土/事変/病原/徴候/定式/諸氏/カルテル

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、神社の、本気で、絶対、巫女、絶対、文化、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on shrine miko culture was genuinely impressive. The depth of your research really stood out.
lines.style: Warm, steady appreciation. Slight lean forward. Clear enunciation on key phrases. Genuine curiosity underlying the praise, not routine acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古代遺跡から、本気で、絶対、出土、絶対、した、絶対、土器、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to incorporate findings from ancient excavation sites—especially the pottery records. Your feedback meant a lot to my research.
lines.style: Humble but engaged. Careful articulation, especially on the academic terms. Eyes up briefly to meet hers. Gratitude that's felt but not overplayed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、満州、絶対、事変、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The way you handled the Manchurian Incident material in wartime context showed such intellectual maturity. You really grasped the scope of it all.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Measured pace. Slight nod of recognition mid-sentence. Sincere regard—she's genuinely seeing his capability.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。感染症の、本気で、絶対、病原、絶対、菌、絶対、研究史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I also spent considerable time on the historical context of infectious disease research—the pathogens, the methods. I wanted to understand the depth there.
lines.style: Quiet focus. Slight hesitation before diving into detail—showing care in how he explains. Genuine engagement with the subject matter, not just recitation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文明衰退の、本気で、絶対、徴候、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your analysis of civilizational decline patterns was really thoughtful. The way you worked through those markers showed real intellectual rigor.
lines.style: Direct eye contact. Steady, affirming tone. Slow enough to let weight settle on each key point. Respect in her posture.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史学の、本気で、絶対、定式、絶対、化、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to trace how historical methodology itself became standardized over time—the whole process of how we formalize historical inquiry.
lines.style: Careful pacing. Slight catch in breath before technical phrases, showing the precision matters to him. Genuine intellectual satisfaction, not just deference.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 明治期の学者、本気で、絶対、諸氏、絶対、の業績、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you integrated the work of those Meiji-era scholars—their individual contributions and intellectual legacies. That was really well done.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Gentle emphasis on 'their contributions.' Not rushing. The voice of someone who sees a student thinking clearly for the first time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦前の、本気で、絶対、企業、絶対、カルテル、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to understand how pre-war corporate cartels functioned economically—the structures, the documents. It felt important to the larger historical picture.
lines.style: Soft confidence in his voice. Measured delivery. Trailing slightly upward at the end—still open, still learning, still grateful. Genuine intellectual curiosity.
